# NEORV32 Submodule Local Patches

> NEORV32 submodule pinned at **v1.13.1** (release tag `72fbfc57`).
> This document tracks all local modifications to the submodule.
> When upgrading NEORV32 to a new release, re-apply each patch listed below.

## Auto-generated Files (no action needed on upgrade)

| File | Nature |
|------|--------|
| `rtl/core/neorv32_bootrom_image.vhd` | Bootloader ROM image, generated by deploy script |
| `rtl/core/neorv32_imem_image.vhd` | IMEM 64KB firmware image, generated by deploy script |

These files are regenerated every time `deploy_de2shell_rtos.sh` compiles the bootloader or application. They cause the `dirty` flag on the submodule but are not manual edits.

## Source Patches (manual, re-apply on upgrade)

### 1. Bootloader: Bus OK scan after SDRAM self-test

**File**: `sw/bootloader/main.c`

**Location**: after `system_sdram_selftest()`, before auto boot sequence

**Change**: Added quick bus probe of all 9 Wishbone slaves:

```c
static const struct { const char *name; uint32_t base; } devs[] = {
    {"VGA",    0xF0000000u}, {"PS/2",  0xF0008000u}, {"LCD", 0xF000B000u},
    {"IR",     0xF000C000u}, {"NTT",    0xF000F000u}, {"Exp", 0xF0010000u},
    {"Conway", 0xF0011000u}, {"Synth",  0xF0012000u}, {"GPU", 0xF0015000u},
};
// probe each base address, print "Bus OK (9/9)" or "Bus FAIL (n/9)"
```

**Reason**: Early boot verification that all peripherals are reachable on the Wishbone bus, before the main application loads.

### 2. Bootloader: Shorten SDRAM self-test pause

**File**: `sw/bootloader/hal/source/system.c`

**Change**:
```c
// before
#define SDRAM_TEST_PAUSE_S   5u

// after
#define SDRAM_TEST_PAUSE_S   2u
```

All `uart_puts("Pause 5s")` strings also updated to `"Pause 2s"`.

**Reason**: During development, frequent resets make 5s wait too long. Can revert to 5s for production.

### 3. Bootloader: Add color macros

**File**: `sw/bootloader/hal/include/uart.h`

**Change**:
```c
// existing
#define VT_TERM_HL_ON  "\033[1;31m" // red highlighting

// added
#define VT_TERM_GREEN  "\033[1;32m"
#define VT_TERM_RED    "\033[1;31m"
```

**Reason**: Color-coded Bus OK (green) / FAIL (red) output.

## Configuration Overrides (via generic parameters, no source changes)

These are set in our wrapper/top-level VHDL and Makefiles, not by editing NEORV32 source:

| Config | Upstream Default | Our Value | Where Set |
|--------|-----------------|-----------|-----------|
| UART baud | 19200 | 115200 | Deploy script Makefile flags |
| IMEM size | 16KB | 64KB | `neorv32_wrapper.vhd` generic |
| DMEM size | 8KB | 16KB | `neorv32_wrapper.vhd` generic |
| Boot mode | 0 | 0 (SDRAM) | Top-level VHDL |

## Upgrade Checklist

When updating NEORV32 to a new release:

1. `cd neorv32 && git fetch --tags && git checkout <new-tag>`
2. Re-apply patch #1 (Bus OK scan in `main.c`)
3. Re-apply patch #2 (SDRAM pause 5→2 in `system.c`)
4. Re-apply patch #3 (color macros in `uart.h`)
5. Rebuild bootloader + application: `./run/deploy_de2shell_rtos.sh full`
6. Board test: verify bootloader prints "Bus OK (9/9)", firmware uploads at 115200 baud
